title: Seriously disappointing mish-mash of stuff few would want
text:
This didn't feel like folks trying to get us to like new products. It felt like folks giving stuff they had too much of. I got
*1 lip masque
*Stick deodorant for my feet
* Blotting papers
* Aloe vera gel
*Cooling spray
*Black eyeliner.

I doubt I will use any of it.
label: negative
